reference_recipe: EXP-DENSENET121-TRANSFER-5SEEDS-029-256px-9c23ac05: same dataset, augmentation, schedule, seeds and selection rule
comparison_scope: single-factor change versus the DeiT-Small EXP-015 baseline: Stage 2 learning-rate scheme (layer-wise decay) and unfreeze depth; all other settings identical to the DenseNet121 EXP-029 / EXP-015 recipe

model_specific_differences.backbone: DeiT-Small distilled (KerasHub, ImageNet-1k), 21,689,472 parameters at 256 px
model_specific_differences.input_resolution: 256x256 like both references; the 224 px preset position grid (14x14) is resampled bicubically to 16x16, CLS and DIST rows kept
model_specific_differences.preprocessing_inside_model: x/255 then ImageNet mean/std, identical to the DenseNet121 reference
model_specific_differences.head: two new 5-class heads (CLS and DIST token), Dropout 0.40 each, logits averaged before softmax
model_specific_differences.stage2_trainable_rule: last 8 of 12 encoder blocks + final LayerNorm (embeddings and earlier blocks frozen); LR = 5e-05 x 0.75 ** (11 - block index): 14,196,480 backbone parameters (65.5%); DenseNet121 reference 2,129,920, ResNet50 peer 14,953,472
model_specific_differences.normalization: LayerNorm has no running statistics, so no BatchNorm-style freeze applies (the CNNs keep BatchNorm frozen)
model_specific_differences.exp016_declared_deviation: Stage 2 learning rate is NOT the flat 1e-5 of the references: lr(encoder block i) = base_lr * 0.75 ** (11 - i) for the unfrozen blocks; final LayerNorm and both heads use base_lr; embeddings frozen; weight decay applies the unscaled base_lr (about 5e-9 relative shrink per step). Baseline for comparison: EXP-VIT-DEITSMALL-TRANSFER-5SEEDS-015-256px-d4379a48.

model.position_embedding: 224 px 14x14 patch grid resampled bicubically to 16x16; CLS and DIST rows kept
model.head: CLS and DIST tokens -> Dropout(0.40) -> Dense(5) each; logits averaged; softmax
model.preprocessing: inside model: x/255, then ImageNet mean/std (identical to DenseNet121 reference)

stage2.optimizer: LayerwiseLRAdamW (AdamW with a per-variable learning-rate multiplier)
stage2.learning_rate_rule: lr(encoder block i) = base_lr * 0.75 ** (11 - i) for the unfrozen blocks; final LayerNorm and both heads use base_lr; embeddings frozen; weight decay applies the unscaled base_lr (about 5e-9 relative shrink per step)

config.rule_text: last 8 of 12 encoder blocks + final LayerNorm (embeddings and earlier blocks frozen); LR = 5e-05 x 0.75 ** (11 - block index)

selection_rule: lowest Validation loss, higher Validation macro-F1, Stage 1 on tie
deployment_rule: lowest Validation loss, higher macro-F1, lower seed on tie
selection_note: Both the real_ subgroup ranking and the val_loss ranking are written to selection_comparison.json. Holdout and Test never select.
test_protocol: enabled Final Test after five-seed Validation lock; no model selection
holdout_protocol: holdout leakage audited before training; predictions only after Validation lock; descriptive audit, not a blind benchmark
